description:
JET 9 CARBON
For riders who want something beautiful, versatile and fun, we present the Jet 9 Carbon. Described as "...truly an eye opener" by the guys at Bike Mag, the 100mm of CVA™ suspension can handle both your weekend races and light trail bike efforts - without flinching and without breaking the bank.
The Jet 9 Carbon features the same geometry and handling characteristics as the Jet 9 RDO, and is available in a range of carefully planned complete bike options - all designed to get you out on the trail and out from behind your desk.
DESIGN
The Jet 9 Carbon is functional and beautiful. We utilize the same tests that drive our RDO program to determine the targets for strength, stiffness and damping characteristics for the Jet 9 Carbon. Combine the engineering with boutique looks, custom suspension linkage and unique alloy hardware for a signature frame that can’t be beat.
CVA SUSPENSION
The Jet 9 Carbon features Niner’s patented CVA suspension (U.S. Patent No. 7,934,739) and delivers 100mm of fully active travel with superb compliance and damping via a tuned for CVA Fox Float CTD Evolution rear shock. For those seeking the the only suspension system designed around 29ers with pedaling efficiency in every chainring, CVA is a faster and smoother ride.
PERFORMANCE GEOMETRY
Precise handling, stability and maneuverability are all keys to the award winning Niner ride and are in ample supply on the Jet 9 Carbon. The Jet 9 Carbon is equiped with a 100mm Rock Shox Recon Gold for nimble, responsive steering.
C5 WARRANTY
Our robust R&D program - computer modeling, physical prototype testing (both in-house and at independent testing facilities) and hours of ride testing under highly skilled and abusive test riders leave us confident that the Jet 9 Carbon is going to exceed your expectations. We maintain that our carbon fiber testing and design rivals the best in the bike industry. Rather than just talking about it, we choose to demonstrate this commitment via our C5 warranty (five year) and commitment to customer service.
ATTENTION TO DETAIL
When it comes to details, we don’t skimp on the Jet 9 Carbon - forged suspension linkages and unique Niner suspension hardware, replaceable derailleur hanger, integrated carbon head tube and and precise alloy brake and derailleur interfaces means that riders can utilize the latest technology and depend on a trouble-free ride.
Carbon full suspension from the only 29er only mountain bike company
Forged alloy suspension linkage and unique Niner hardware
Brand new XS size

frame.front_derailleur_mount: DIRECT MOUNT (SRAM S3 OR SHIMANO “E2”) BOTTOM PULL
